question: Stand-alone game systems found in public venues such as malls and amusement parks:
extra: Arcade games are stand-alone game systems found in public venues such as malls and amusement parks.

question: Primary controls used for arcade games while the player is typically standing up:
extra: Most arcade games are played standing up with player controls consisting of buttons, joysticks, or a combination.

question: Game systems usually played in the home and hooked up to a television set:
extra: Console systems are usually played in the home, hooked up to a television set.

question: The primary consequence of the console platform being proprietary:
choices: Players can modify the internal hardware easily
Games are open-source and free to distribute
They do not require a television set to play
extra: The console platform is proprietary, which means hardware manufacturers have control over what software is developed for their respective platforms.

question: Game platform typically played on desktop computers and laptops:
extra: Computer games are played on desktop computers and laptops.

question: Reason the computer platform adds complexity to the game development process:
choices: Non-standard setups and a variety of systems
Inability to connect to the Internet
Requirement to stand up while playing
answer: Non-standard setups and a variety of systems
extra: The computer platform adds complexity to the development process due to non-standard setups and a variety of systems.

question: Platform characteristic that involves thousands of simultaneous players and requires game information to be stored on several servers:
extra: The largest online games involve thousands of simultaneous players, which sometimes requires that the information for the game be stored on several servers.

question: A lightweight, portable game console with a built-in screen, game controls, and speakers:
extra: A handheld gaming device is a lightweight, portable game console with a built-in screen, game controls, and speakers.

question: The primary advantage provided by the small size of handheld gaming devices:
choices: Convenience to be taken almost anywhere
Ability to host thousands of servers
answer: Convenience to be taken almost anywhere
extra: The small size of handheld devices makes it convenient for them to be taken with the player almost anywhere.

question: Games specifically designed for smartphones, tablets, and portable media players:
extra: Mobile games are games designed for mobile devices, such as smartphones, tablets, and portable media players.

question: Feature of mobile devices that directly enables wireless multiplayer games:
extra: Mobile devices have a wide range of connectivity features allowing wireless multiplayer games.

question: Game category that includes board, card, and dice games played on flat physical surfaces:
extra: Tabletop games are played on top of tables and include board, card, and dice games.

question: A recognized example of a pen-and-paper tabletop game:
extra: Tabletop games include pen-and-paper games such as Dungeons and Dragons, where game pieces literally consist of pens and paper.

question: Time-dependent elements that affect the pacing of the game and determine if it is played reflexively or reflectively:
extra: Time intervals are time-dependent elements that affect the pacing of the game.

question: Time interval allowing each player, whether artificial or human, an unlimited allotted time to make a move:
extra: Games that are turn-based allow each player to take a turn, and usually, the time allotted for each turn is unlimited.

question: Game genre that traditionally allows players as much time as they need to plan their moves:
extra: In traditional board and card games, players have as much time as they need to plan their moves.

question: Time interval characterized by the complete absence of turns or intervals between actions:
extra: The opposite of a turn-based game is known as a real-time game, where there is no time interval between turns. In fact, there are no turns at all.

question: Reason real-time games are extremely popular in online environments:
choices: They give players unlimited time to think
They allow communication in real-time with other players
They restrict gameplay to a single artificial character
They require pen and paper to calculate moves
answer: They allow communication in real-time with other players
extra: Real-time games are extremely popular online partially due to the ability to communicate in real-time with other players.

question: Time interval that functions as a compromise between turn-based and real-time mechanics:
extra: A time-limited game is a compromise between turn-based and real-time games.

question: A scenario where a time limit is placed on the entire game itself rather than individual turns:
extra: In the case of some single-player puzzle games, a time limit is placed on the game itself.

question: Design element that directly correlates to the number of people playing a game:
extra: There are several possible player modes, which directly correlate to the number of people playing a game.

question: Terminology for additional entities in a single-player game acting as opponents:
extra: Any additional players (usually opponents) in a single-player game are known as artificial intelligence (AI) characters or non-player characters (NPCs).

question: Alternative name for a two-player mode where individuals play directly against each other:
extra: In two-player mode (also known as head-to-head game), two players play against each other or team up to fight a common enemy.

question: Gameplay structure where two players team up to fight a common enemy rather than fighting each other:
extra: In two-player mode, two players play against each other or team up to fight a common enemy.

question: Mode where all players sit in the same space, sharing a single screen while using separate controllers:
extra: In local multiplayer mode, all players sit in the same space and play the game on the same machine, sharing the same screen using separate input devices.

question: Game systems known for commonly supporting local play for up to four players on a shared screen:
extra: Local multiplayer is a common mode of play on console systems, which allow for local play of up to four players.

question: Multiplayer mode that allows players in one physical area to share a game network without sharing screens:
extra: LAN-based games allow players to share the game on a local area network without sharing the screen or input device.

question: Innovation enabled by LAN-based games regarding connectivity:
choices: Removing the need for computer hardware entirely
Combining networking capabilities of online mainframes with personal computers in one local area
Allowing mobile phones to connect to arcade machines
Eliminating artificial intelligence from single-player games
answer: Combining networking capabilities of online mainframes with personal computers in one local area
extra: With LAN-based games, it became possible to combine the networking capabilities of online mainframe games with personal computers that could be placed in one local area.

question: A defining characteristic of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games (MMORPGs):
choices: They are strictly played on local networks
They limit participation to two players
extra: An MMORPG persists 24 hours per day and maintains a subscription-based revenue model.

question: Common revenue model used to maintain a persistent Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game:
extra: An MMORPG maintains a subscription-based revenue model in which players pay a monthly fee to continue playing it.
